about: Per cell, one sha256 per system and mode, of the leaderboard.csv row the open columns hold, as JSON text. The numbers themselves are published on the leaderboard, not in this repository. Every column October had is the text the October leaderboard.csv wrote. The wts_* columns are younger than October, so theirs is the text the 2.0.0 scorer wrote from the same frozen inputs. A system scored under an internal recipe name appears under its public name, which evals/systems.py maps it to.
